name: Haus Tyrol
beschreibung: The Haus Tyrol is located in the village of Gerlos in the Zillertal. The holiday apartments are equipped with a kitchen, a bathroom and a living area. A parking space and a ski storage room are part of the amenities. The Dorfbahn is just a few minutes' walk from the house. In winter, guests can use the nearby ski slopes. In summer, hiking trails and cycle routes are directly accessible. The balcony offers a view of the mountain landscape. The accommodation is suitable for couples and families.
